population.span: in 18,201 patients with atrial fibrillation and at least one additional risk factor for stroke.

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke or systemic embolism.

estimate.span: The rate of the primary outcome was 1.27% per year in the apixaban group, as compared with 1.60% per year in the warfarin group (hazard ratio with apixaban, 0.79; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.66 to 0.95; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.01 for superiority).

ci.span: The rate of the primary outcome was 1.27% per year in the apixaban group, as compared with 1.60% per year in the warfarin group (hazard ratio with apixaban, 0.79; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.66 to 0.95; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P=0.01 for superiority).

analysis_set.span: POPULATION: Intention to treat analysis, randomized participants.

treatment_strategy.span: In this randomized, double-blind trial, we compared apixaban (at a dose of 5 mg twice daily) with warfarin (target international normalized ratio, 2.0 to 3.0)

follow_up.span: The median duration of follow-up was 1.8 years.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The registry identifies nonvalvular atrial fibrillation and requires age ≥ 18 years with an additional stroke risk factor.
